title: Supply Risk Reduction — Qualifying Backup Suppliers
result: A structured assessment for sourcing alternatives
summary: Used pre-audit assessments to evaluate potential alternatives across components, including motors, heaters and printed circuit board assemblies.
context: Adding alternatives required assessing whether candidate suppliers could meet manufacturing and quality requirements as well as commercial needs.
decisions: I combined quote analysis with on-site supplier validation and financial review. The sourcing playbook and pre-audit workbooks supported comparison of candidate suppliers.
outcome: The process helped identify candidates for further qualification across several categories.
